data_caveats: os NULL on ~12% of android rows (coalesced to 'unknown'); is_back_filled rows excluded; guest sessions have no application_id at click time.

insights.headline: Guest-browse card clicks convert to application_started ~38% worse than logged-in clicks.
insights.evidence: guest 6.1% vs logged-in 9.8% (application_started / destination_card_clicked), 2026-05-01→08-01, n=41,203 clicks.
insights.why: Guests hit the auth wall before they can start an application; consistent with the funnel's known auth drop, not a card/page defect.
insights.confidence_reason: Large sample, stable week-over-week, metric defined in context.
insights.suggested_next_step: A/B a lightweight guest checkout that defers auth until after application_started.
insights.evidence_sql: SELECT is_guest_browse, countMerge(clicks) AS clicks FROM atlys.destination_click_daily_agg GROUP BY is_guest_browse

insights.headline: page_version v4 lifts click→application by ~5pp overall vs v3.
insights.why: v4's clearer visa-type chips likely reduce mis-clicks; aligns with the v4 rollout note K7.
insights.confidence_reason: Consistent across destinations but rollout only ~6 weeks; not yet a full seasonal cycle.
insights.suggested_next_step: Graduate v4 to 100% outside iOS-Gulf; keep the v3 holdback for one more cycle.
insights.evidence_sql: SELECT page_version, countMerge(clicks) FROM atlys.destination_click_daily_agg GROUP BY page_version

insights.headline: The v4 lift disappears for iOS users in the Gulf — flat vs v3.
insights.evidence: iOS + AE/SA: v4 6.4% vs v3 6.5% (flat), n=1,910 clicks.
insights.why: Coincides with K1 (iOS WebKit OTP autofill regression) at the downstream pay step, capping realized conversion regardless of page_version.
insights.confidence_reason: Gulf-iOS segment is small (n=1,910) and the link to K1 is correlational, not proven.
insights.suggested_next_step: Segment the v4 rollout dashboard by os×region and hold v4 for iOS-Gulf until K1 ships.
insights.evidence_sql: SELECT page_version, os, geoip_country_code, ... WHERE os='ios' AND geoip_country_code IN ('AE','SA')
